channel.title: InvestPR Media Monitoring
channel.description: Wins this period include Accelerant becoming the first international reinsurer authorized under Act 130-2025, new Puerto Rico entries from Wahlburgers and Planet Fitness, and Pompina Investments' $8M commitment at Isla Grande alongside a $25.6M federal runway rebuild. Federal money is landing, including an $8M NSF stem-cell and AI center at UPR Mayagüez, a $19.9M NIH renewal, and a U.S. Air Force report of a $161.4M economic impact. Banks are on track for record profits, but manufacturing PMI fell to 45.8, the lowest since November 2024, and energy costs are weighing on businesses. Key risks are the New Fortress Energy LNG dispute, which has San Juan units burning diesel while the government seeks alternative supply, and Yum!
